objections.text: The manuscript risks presenting stage decomposition or retrieval-versus-use as the contribution even though recent memory evaluation work already studies active utilization and post-retrieval reuse. The irreducible residual must be the same-trajectory reward-conditioned writer intervention plus the diagnostic ambiguity across coarse views.

The first stage whose primary test is not supported is not necessarily the latent point where transport attenuates: stage metrics, sample units, and test sensitivities differ. Call b* an evidence-localization boundary unless matched-power interventions identify a causal bottleneck.

The 125/172 retrieval statistic establishes retrieval of the branch-conditioned source-memory item, not exposure to or use of the reward-specific residual inside that item. Wording that says branch-specific content was exposed overstates the measured variable.

Forced fixed-evidence injection and native reuse are different intervention surfaces. The forced positive result can show capacity under supplied context, but it cannot rule out context-dependent native downstream insensitivity or be treated as a missing native stage.

Reddit replicates write-versus-terminal separation only; it does not measure Shopping-style native exposure and first-action uptake. The exposure-to-uptake evidence boundary is therefore Shopping-specific on current evidence.

A claim that the true causal bottleneck is at action uptake would require matched stage interventions/power or mediation evidence not in the frozen contract. Preserve this as a limitation rather than proposing an experiment implicitly.

objections.text: Artifact inspection confirms the contribution is not generic lifecycle decomposition. Related Work should explicitly absorb QCR, Mem2ActBench, and retrieval-versus-utilization diagnostics, then state the residual as controlled same-trajectory writer intervention plus coarsening ambiguity on the same frozen update.

The stage-evidence artifacts preserve heterogeneous evidence semantics but do not equalize statistical power across stages. This supports first-unsupported-evidence localization, not an identified latent attenuation onset.

Artifact evidence binds retrieval events at the source-memory-item level; no qualified semantic residual exposure variable exists. Manuscript language must distinguish item exposure from treatment-specific residual exposure.

The forced matrix is well receipted but deliberately bypasses native retrieval/context composition. Its admissible inference is downstream capacity under supplied evidence, not a direct estimate of native transport or proof that native policy would respond if it attended.

The Reddit artifact supports cross-domain write/terminal separation and sign heterogeneity, but contains no matching native exposure/first-action ladder. Keep the action-uptake boundary scoped to Shopping.
CBRG stopped before behavioral method evaluation; artifact-aware review finds this boundary correctly represented and it must remain outside the paper contribution.
